summary: The note describes Krasnovishersky District, one of the thirty-three administrative districts (raions) of Perm Krai, Russia, which is incorporated as Krasnovishersky Municipal District. It lies in the northeast of the krai in the Vishera River valley and borders the Komi Republic, Sverdlovsk Oblast, Cherdynsky District, Solikamsky District and the town of krai significance of Alexandrovsk. Its administrative center is the town of Krasnovishersk, which accounts for 71.4% of the district's population.
one_line: Krasnovishersky District is an administrative district of Perm Krai, Russia, centered on the town of Krasnovishersk in the Vishera River valley.
key_facts: Krasnovishersky District is one of the thirty-three administrative districts (raions) of Perm Krai, Russia.
The district is incorporated municipally as Krasnovishersky Municipal District.
Krasnovishersky District is located in the northeast of Perm Krai, in the valley of the Vishera River.
Krasnovishersky District borders the Komi Republic to the north.
Krasnovishersky District borders Sverdlovsk Oblast to the east.
Krasnovishersky District borders Cherdynsky District to the west.
Krasnovishersky District borders Solikamsky District to the south.
Krasnovishersky District borders the territory of the town of krai significance of Alexandrovsk to the southeast.
The administrative center of Krasnovishersky District is the town of Krasnovishersk.
The population of Krasnovishersk accounts for 71.4% of the district's total population.
The note does not give the district's area figure in usable form.
